title: Clícalo AI template answer, contract v1
description: What an AI provider must answer to a template generation (PLA-008, ADR-0014, blueprint §9.2). Self-contained on purpose: Infrastructure.Ai checks the same rules in code (AiResponseReader) before the semantic check of Domain (TemplateSchema), and a future proxy may share it without Domain. Only key combinations can be proposed: no Web, App, Macro or Text.

known.description: Whether the AI knows the program; false shows the unknown-program notice (PLA-007).

process.description: Its executable without path; ignored when known is false (the process is never guessed, PLA-007).

icon.description: Material Symbols Rounded icon of the profile.

name.description: The name in Spanish and English (Timings.Ai.AiNameMaxLength characters at most).

keys.description: Key ids of data/catalogs/keys.json in press order.

confidence.description: How sure the AI is, from 0 to 1.
